description.en: The USB Standard-A (Series A) receptacle interface: an opening 12.50 × 5.12 mm with a contact tongue along one side, taking a Standard-A plug one way up.
description.es: La interfaz del receptáculo USB Estándar A (Serie A): una abertura de 12.50 × 5.12 mm con una lengüeta de contactos a lo largo de un lado, que recibe una clavija Estándar A en una sola posición.
description.fr: L'interface de l'embase USB Standard-A (série A) : une ouverture de 12,50 × 5,12 mm avec une languette de contacts le long d'un côté, qui reçoit une fiche Standard-A dans un seul sens.
description.pt: A interface do receptáculo USB Standard-A (Série A): uma abertura de 12,50 × 5,12 mm com uma lingueta de contatos ao longo de um lado, que recebe uma ficha Standard-A num só sentido.

sources.title: Universal Serial Bus Specification, Revision 2.0 (April 27, 2000), chapter 6
sources.supports: Figure 6-7 (Series A receptacle interface): opening 12.50 ±0.10 wide, 5.12 ±0.10 high; tongue 11.10 ±0.10 wide, 8.38 ±0.08 long; 8.88 ±0.20 from the tongue root to the front face; contacts at ±1.00 and ±3.50 from the centre line, 1.00 ±0.05 wide; mated, 2.67 min from the receptacle face to the plug's overmold. Figure 6-9 (Series A plug): shell 12.00 ±0.10 wide, 4.50 ±0.10 high; 11.75 min from the tip to the overmold; cavity 8.65 ±0.19 deep; overmold 16.0 max wide, 8.0 max high. Table 6-1: four contacts and the shell

sources.title: USB 3.1 Legacy Cable and Connector Specification, Revision 1.0 (September 22, 2017)
sources.supports: Figure 5-1 detail Y: the Standard-A receptacle opening 12.50 ±0.10 × 5.12 ±0.10 and the 11.10 ±0.10 tongue width, labelled; Figure 5-4: the Standard-A plug shell 12.00 ±0.10 × 4.50 ±0.10

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the opening on the receptacle's front (mating) face. +z points out of the opening, toward a plug; +x runs along the opening's width; +y = z × x runs along its height, pointing from the contact tongue toward the open half of the cavity. The body behind the face lies at z < 0.

opening_width.note: the USB 3.1 legacy specification's Figure 5-1 labels it (source 1)

cavity_depth.note: from the tongue root to the front face

plug_overmold_width_max.note: the opening an enclosure leaves must clear the plug's overmold

mated_gap_min.note: from the receptacle's front face to the plug's overmold, mated

interfaces.note: Female: a Standard-A plug enters the opening. Symmetry 1: it goes in one way up, its contact insulator into the open half of the cavity beside the tongue.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The USB 2.0 specification is free from the USB-IF document library; the USB 3.1 legacy connector specification's clearer drawing confirms which feature each Series A number belongs to. No panel cutout or normative housing envelope is given, so the body is not modelled.
